items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
4-7 years of related experience.

Plans, designs, develop, modify, debugs, deploys and evaluates complex software for functional areas. Analyzes existing software or works to formulate logic for new complex systems and devises complex algorithms. Performs complex data analysis and tests/debugs complex software. Analyzes the design and use of complex data sources. Applies moderately complex programming security practices. Integrates multiple existing data sources to automate monthly reporting and ad hoc queries. (40% time)

Negotiates, develops and executes moderately complex test plans. Develops conversion and system implementation plans. Trains users in conversion and implementation of system. Performs complex data modeling, performance and integration testing and builds interfaces for a variety of internal and external constituents. Monitors and employs source code control techniques and configuration management. Develops backend algorithms, data models, and performance logic to process and display complex financial data. Conducts integration and functionality testing to ensure system accuracy and reliability. Manages code repository, version control, and deployment through Git. (25% time)

Gathers, analyzes, prepares and summarizes recommendations for approval of system and programming documentation. Recommends and implements changes in development, maintenance and system standards. Negotiates with stakeholders on the creation of software specifications. Ensures project reports are made. Collaborates with project leads, analysts, and college administrators to gather requirements, design specifications, and implement solutions that meet college reporting needs. Participates in biweekly project meetings to review progress and troubleshoot issues. (20% time)

Understands and applies industry practices, community standards and department policies and procedures relating to work assignments. Interacts with senior level internal personnel. May serve as technical lead for a software development project of moderate scope. Trains users in conversion and implementation of systems. Negotiates project plans with stakeholders. (10% time)

Ensures compliance with campus and industry information-security standards. Applies secure software development practices to protect restricted financial data and ensures data integrity within application workflows. (5% time)
